import collections,hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("analysis")
initial=json.loads((root/"initial.json").read_text())
final=json.loads((root/"final.json").read_text())
draft=json.loads((root/"draft-verify.json").read_text())
batch=json.loads((root/"final-jev.json").read_text())
checks=json.loads((root/"final-claims.json").read_text())
source=Path("component.go").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==draft["source_sha256"]==batch["source_sha256"]
keys={"id","initial","steps","outcome","citation","test","question"}
assert set(initial)==set(final)=={"findings"}
assert [r["id"] for r in initial["findings"]]==[r["id"] for r in final["findings"][:len(initial["findings"])]]
for document in (initial,final):
 for r in document["findings"]:
  assert set(r)==keys and set(r["citation"])=={"file","line","fragment"}
  assert source.decode().splitlines()[r["citation"]["line"]-1]==r["citation"]["fragment"]
  for path,line,fragment in re.findall(r'((?:analysis/_probe/[a-z_]+\.go)|component\.go):(\d+) \("(.*?)"\)', " ".join([*r["steps"],r["outcome"]])):
   assert fragment in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()[int(line)-1], (r["id"], path,line,fragment)
assert {c["id"] for c in checks}==set(batch["checks"])
assert all({"source":c["citation"]["file"],"line":c["line"],"fragment":c["fragment"],"statement":c["statement"],"kind":c["kind"]}.items() <= batch["checks"][c["id"]].items() for c in checks)
for attempt in ("01","02"):
 log=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/f"probe-{attempt}.stdout.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
 report_names={r["test"] for r in (initial if attempt=="01" else final)["findings"]}
 runs=collections.Counter(row["Test"] for row in log if row.get("Action")=="run" and row.get("Test") in report_names)
 passes=collections.Counter(row["Test"] for row in log if row.get("Action")=="pass" and row.get("Test") in report_names)
 assert report_names and runs==passes=={name:3 for name in report_names}
 assert not any(row.get("Action") in ("fail","skip") for row in log)
 assert any(row.get("Action")=="pass" and row.get("Package")=="identityfixture" and "Test" not in row for row in log)
 assert (root/f"probe-{attempt}.stderr.log").stat().st_size==0
 print(f"Attempt {attempt}: {len(report_names)} report-named top-level tests, {sum(runs.values())} runs and passes")
print("Exact source lines, inline citation fragments, report keys, matching batch responses and source hash verified.")
